description: Free deal check for an Oklahoma City small-commercial flip: says whether it works at the asking price, is close, is too rich, or works at no price, on OKC hard-money terms (75% of price at 11% plus 2 points, 2% buy closing, 7% sale costs, $1,000/month carry unless given, minimum 5-month hold, 12% profit-on-cost target). It does not return the max modeled price; it returns a link where the person can buy the full OKC Flip Report (exact max modeled price, break-even, price ladder, what-if checks, cost sheet) with the deal already filled in. Give exit_value, or annual_noi and cap_rate.

address.description: Optional address, for your own reference.

annual_noi.description: Alternative to exit_value: stabilized yearly net operating income, USD.

building_sf.description: Optional building square feet, for per-square-foot figures.

cap_rate.description: With annual_noi: the cap rate as a decimal, e.g. 0.085.

carry_per_month.description: Taxes, insurance, utilities per month while held. Default 1000.

exit_value.description: Expected sale price after the work, USD. Base it on sold comps.

hold_months.description: Months from contract to resale. Default 6, minimum 5.

notify_email.description: Optional. Leave an email if the person wants Dark Matter Syndicate to follow up about this deal. Only stored if given.

name: okc_flip_math
title: Small-commercial flip math
